description: Group-dragging a squad must not bury the ghosts under the green reach circles. Part A drives the real mouse path — click the unit, SHIFT drag-box all four Witchseekers, then a drag that is PAUSED mid-flight (drag_board release:false) so the live drag frame can be inspected before mouse_up_board drops it. Part B repeats the check on the pad carry, the one path that deliberately LIFTS the reach ring (dash.z_index = 50) so the clamp boundary reads over board tokens — it must still pass under the ghost. Asserts over effective z-index (walking the z_as_relative parent chain, i.e. the key the renderer sorts on): (1) every ghost draws above every child of MoveRangeVisual, MovementERVisual and MovementCoherencyVisual; (2) the distance-moved readout parented to the ghosts clears them too; (3) the dashed reach circles are drawn thin (<= 6 board px) so N overlapping per-model circles stay legible. Screenshots capture the mid-drag frames a player actually sees.

steps.script:
var m = tree.root.get_node("Main")
m.view_zoom = 2.5
m.view_offset = Vector2(940.0, 130.0) - Vector2(930.0, 450.0) / 2.5
m.update_view_transform()
return true
